warnings.CATALOG_CALLABLE_METRICS_UNDECLARED: Spec "{{spec}}" of {{model_id}} runs the callable engine but declares no api.metrics, so the monitoring center shows no engine metrics for it unless its /metrics happens to use vLLM or SGLang metric names.
warnings.CATALOG_HEALTH_ENDPOINT_UNDECLARED: Spec "{{spec}}" of {{model_id}} runs the callable engine but declares no api.health_endpoint, so its readiness is probed on the default /health.
warnings.CATALOG_CALLABLE_SERVED_NAME_FIXED: Spec "{{spec}}" of {{model_id}} runs the callable engine but passes --served-model-name {{name}} instead of ${SERVED_MODEL_NAME}. The gateway and the health check send the deployment's served name, so an engine that checks the model rejects requests unless you deploy it under exactly that name.
warnings.CATALOG_DISPLAY_PROFILE_RETIRED: Spec "{{spec}}" of {{model_id}} still sets display_profile or gpus.display_target. Both are no longer used and were ignored on import; name the spec with display_name_zh_cn and display_name_en instead.
warnings.CATALOG_ARG_PASSED_THROUGH: Spec "{{spec}}" of {{model_id}} passes {{flag}} {{value}}, which the platform parameter dictionary cannot read. It goes to the engine verbatim, but the deploy form and the memory estimate do not see it.
